description: This file defines the Configuration class for handling the 'use FIPS endpoint' setting within the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes a constructor that validates the input, a method to check if FIPS endpoint usage is enabled, and a method to represent the configuration as an array.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Implements configuration handling for the 'use FIPS endpoint' option in AWS SDK.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Configuration object and validates the input.

methods.name: isUseFipsEndpoint
methods.description: Returns whether FIPS endpoint usage is enabled.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the configuration as an associative array.
